        result.append('            object.__setattr__(self, name, value)')
        result.append('        else:')

        result.append('')

        result.append('        """Return a new VersionInfo with patch incremented."""')
        result.append('        return VersionInfo(')
        result.append('            major=self.major, minor=self.minor, patch=self.patch + 1,')
        result.append('            prerelease=None, build=None)')
        result.append('')

        result.append('            prerelease=pre, build=None)')
        result.append('')
        result.append('    def bump_build(self, token="build"):')
        result.append('        """Return a new VersionInfo with build incremented."""')
        result.append('        if self.build is None:')
        result.append('            bld = token + ".0"')
        result.append('        else:')
        result.append('            parts = self.build.rsplit(".", 1)')
        result.append('            if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():')
        result.append('                bld = parts[0] + "." + str(int(parts[1]) + 1)')
        result.append('            else:')
        result.append('                bld = self.build + ".0"')
        result.append('        return VersionInfo(')
        result.append('            major=self.major, minor=self.minor, patch=self.patch,')
        result.append('            prerelease=self.prerelease, build=bld)')
        result.append('')
        i += 1
        continue
    
    result.append(line)
    i += 1

new_content = '\n'.join(result)
print(f"Total lines: {len(result)}")

# Verify the methods were added
for method in ['__setattr__', '__iter__', 'replace', 'bump_major', 'bump_minor', 'bump_patch', 'bump_prerelease', 'bump_build']:

# Write to file

    f.write(new_content)
